description: This PHP class 'SaveLocationController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling the logic for saving or editing location data within the admin plugin. It manages setting up Vue components and permissions for location-related UI interactions.

classes.name: SaveLocationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling location save/edit operations in the admin panel, setting up Vue components and permissions based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, determining whether it's an edit or save operation based on the presence of an 'id' parameter, and loads the list of countries.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the permission group(s) required to access location data, in this case 'locations'.
